apiKey.title: Triremes API key
apiKey.description: Your own key from triremes.com/account/api. It is sent only to triremes.com, as Authorization: Bearer.

category.title: Business type
category.description: As Triremes names it, for example Dentist, Plumber or Roofing Contractor. Empty: every type.

country.title: Country
country.description: A two-letter code, for example US, GB or DE. Empty: every country.

region.title: State or region
region.description: For example NV or CA. Empty: the whole country.

q.title: Keyword
q.description: Words found in the business type, city, region, country or the name of a gap. Every word must match.

gap.title: Fails this check
gap.description: Only websites that fail this SEO check. Empty: any.
enumTitles: More than 2 redirects to the homepage
HTTP resources on an HTTPS homepage
First byte after more than 1800 ms
No Open Graph title or image
Structured data that is not valid JSON

minimumScore.title: Minimum SEO score (%)
minimumScore.description: Only websites at or above it; 0 keeps every website, those still being measured too. SEO score: the share of Triremes' checks of what search engines can read on this homepage that it fails, weighted by how serious each check is. 0% means no gaps; higher is worse.

limit.title: Most websites
limit.description: The run stops once it has this many.
